# Techniques for Accessible PDF — corpus attribution

The PDF files in this directory are from the PDF Association's *Techniques for
Accessible PDF*, licensed **CC BY 4.0**.

- Source: <https://github.com/pdf-association/techniques-for-accessible-pdf>
- Pinned commit: see `MANIFEST.json` → `commit`
- Licence text: <https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/>
- Attribution: PDF Association, *Techniques for Accessible PDF*

Each file is unmodified from upstream and is pinned by SHA-256 in
`MANIFEST.json`. Upstream publishes additions quarterly; adopting them is a
deliberate re-pin (new commit, regenerated manifest, regenerated coverage
table), never a silent drift.

Test-only. These files are excluded from every shipped artifact, so the
bundled-binary notice inventory carries no row for them; this file and
`MANIFEST.json` are the attribution record.
